serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: This goddamn paper bag broke!
Buahahahahaha! Landlord’s grocery bag broke! Everything is rolling on the ground!
Landlord: Hey! I saw that! Hands off my stuff weirdo! 
Some people are trying to take advantage of the situation and steal some of his stuff.
Landlord: God! Why me?! Why do these things happen only to good people?!
…
Landlord: Shit! My back! Bending down hurts so much!
Landlord: Hey! No one will help me? Come on! What’s wrong with you people?!
Oh man that’s kinda pathetic.
